primary_behavioral_gold.claim: same-class investigation order actually recorded after index time

secondary_sensitivity_gold.claim: an eligible order with a later linked result in the target window
secondary_sensitivity_gold.restriction: must not be renamed to observed order gold

separate_normative_gold.restriction: never inferred from EHR frequency or observed behavior

migration_procedure: run source schema and coverage audit
freeze source-specific terminology mapping and lifecycle semantics
build encounter clock and decision documents
run target/evidence overlap and zero/multi-candidate audit
pre-register coverage and uniqueness gates before looking at final-test
run exploratory method comparison only after a valid behavioral gold exists
freeze protocol and subject split before official final-test
forbidden_migration: copy current MIMIC candidate labels into Hong Kong RWD
treat result rows as order rows
use current source's Inactive semantics without re-audit
use final-test to repair mapping or choose thresholds
